issues: Avatar poster/live-canvas handoff could flash and leave the character invisible after refresh.
Startup work could delay practical text entry by 4-5 seconds.
rootCauses: The cached poster was hidden on a fixed 180 ms timer instead of being tied to a sustained live WebGL frame.
All 27 motion files were started together and runtime consistency traversal repeated on every refresh.
The text area depended on a later click instead of being focus-ready at HTML parse time.
fixes: Removed the avatar poster, Cache Storage handoff, canvas encoding, and preserveDrawingBuffer.
Kept model/texture preload and made the real Live2D canvas the only avatar surface.
Deferred all authored motions until after textures, then loaded them one at a time with 160 ms interaction gaps.
Prioritized intro, arm bridge, and presentation-safe hand motions without deleting any motion.
Disabled redundant per-refresh consistency traversal for bundled motion JSON while retaining normal parsing.
Added native autofocus to the narration textarea.
